A little more about me

Curious about people. Comfortable with technology.

I’m a BCA graduate with a foundation in software development, web technologies, databases, and documentation. I’m currently building practical experience in Human Resources while continuing to explore technology and Human Resources solutions.

As a Human Resources Intern, I’m gaining hands-on experience in recruitment, interview coordination, onboarding, employee documentation, maintaining employee records, and supporting day-to-day Human Resources activities. I enjoy working with people, keeping processes organized, and helping create a smooth experience for candidates and employees.

My technical background also helps me approach Human Resources processes with a structured and problem-solving mindset, while my internship is helping me develop stronger communication, coordination, organization, and people-support skills.

Why BCA to Human Resources?

Technology gave me a foundation. People gave me a direction.

My journey started with a BCA degree, where I built a foundation in technology, problem-solving, systems, and structured thinking. During my studies, I also realized that I enjoy communicating with people, coordinating tasks, and understanding how teams work.

This led me to explore Human Resources, where I can work closely with people while bringing the structured and analytical mindset I developed through my technical background. My current internship is helping me gain practical experience in recruitment, interview coordination, onboarding, employee documentation, and workplace processes.

I see my BCA background as an additional strength rather than something separate from Human Resources. My goal is to bring both together as I continue to learn and grow professionally.
